notes: CDER sterile-manufacturing CGMP letter for a Becton Dickinson subsidiary: inadequate complaint/OOS investigations (foreign matter, missing components, seal defects), a sterility-test failure and product recall tied to a container-closure (stopper) defect, unverified biological-indicator spore populations for a sterilization process, and inadequate cleaning/contamination control including a Streptococcus pneumoniae bioburden excursion. All specific drug names are redacted as (b)(4), so products is empty. linked_to_complaints is false: although complaints and EM/bioburden findings are both discussed extensively, the letter never explicitly ties a named organism to a consumer-complaint sample (unlike the Bausch & Lomb letter's explicit genus/species match).
